title: Zebra with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='27' ry='18' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <!-- body stripes (lit dark blue-purple) -->
    <path d='M28 52 q7 2 6 12 q-1 8 -5 10' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M42 47 q8 2 7 15 q-1 10 -5 13' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M58 46 q8 2 7 15 q-1 10 -6 13' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M72 51 q6 3 4 12 q-1 6 -4 8' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='30' y='75' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <rect x='61' y='75' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <rect x='30' y='80' width='8' height='6' fill='#4b4a86'/>
    <rect x='61' y='80' width='8' height='6' fill='#4b4a86'/>
    <rect x='27' y='90' width='13' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#3a3a6b'/>
    <rect x='59' y='90' width='13' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#3a3a6b'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <path d='M72 55 q10 -12 8 -24 l14 4 q0 16 -10 26 z' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <path d='M76 50 q6 -9 5 -17' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M84 50 q5 -7 4 -13' fill='none' stroke='#4b4a86' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- mane -->
    <path d='M80 28 q4 -8 -2 -13 q9 0 8 10 q6 -4 5 6' fill='#6a68b8'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='24' rx='12' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 82 24)' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='90' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d9d3c6'/>
    <!-- nostril -->
    <circle cx='93' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#4b4a86'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='14' rx='3.5' ry='6' transform='rotate(-25 76 14)' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='15' rx='1.6' ry='3.5' transform='rotate(-25 76 15)' fill='#e78fa5'/>
    <ellipse cx='87' cy='12' rx='3.5' ry='6' transform='rotate(10 87 12)' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
    <ellipse cx='87' cy='13' rx='1.6' ry='3.5' transform='rotate(10 87 13)' fill='#e78fa5'/>
    <!-- sparkly eye -->
    <circle cx='86' cy='22' r='3.6' fill='#2e2c5e'/>
    <circle cx='85.2' cy='21.2' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <path d='M88 20 l0.6 1.4 1.5 0.5 -1.5 0.6 -0.6 1.4 -0.6 -1.4 -1.5 -0.6 1.5 -0.5 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
    <!-- sparkle accents -->
    <path d='M70 8 l0.8 2 2 0.8 -2 0.8 -0.8 2 -0.8 -2 -2 -0.8 2 -0.8 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
    <path d='M94 14 l0.6 1.5 1.5 0.6 -1.5 0.6 -0.6 1.5 -0.6 -1.5 -1.5 -0.6 1.5 -0.6 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
